purpose: Phase-6D tumour-response prediction records. Each documents a labelled prediction: category, confidence, rationale, source/target model + species + formulation, assumptions, uncertainty, limitations, evidence IDs, quantitative-status, and whether it may be shown by default. Predictions never overwrite experimental evidence.

pred_tum_b16bl6_trajectory.claim: The schematic B16BL6 tumour burden declines under cationic-NLC treatment (loss pressure from apoptosis exceeds growth pressure) and rebounds if treatment stops with viable cells remaining.
pred_tum_b16bl6_trajectory.rationale: Direction is experimentally supported (Chen 2012); the burden TRAJECTORY shape is a schematic mechanistic prediction (no extracted curve).
assumptions: population apoptosis couples to tumour loss
pred_tum_b16bl6_trajectory.uncertainty: Exact trajectory shape, rate, and magnitude NOT_REPORTED.
pred_tum_b16bl6_trajectory.limitations: Not a measured growth curve; not a clinical response.

pred_tum_rebound.claim: After treatment discontinuation, a surviving viable fraction can drive rebound growth (rebound_possible -> rebound_in_progress).
pred_tum_rebound.rationale: Mechanistic: treatment removes suppression/loss; residual viable cells resume growth. Not experimentally measured here.
assumptions: growth pressure recovers when treatment stops

pred_tum_human_exploratory.claim: A human tumour-response view would be a mechanistic extrapolation from preclinical evidence only.
pred_tum_human_exploratory.rationale: No human melanoma population exists in Profile B; any human trajectory is exploratory and NOT validated. Runtime keeps human UNAVAILABLE (population-gated).
pred_tum_human_exploratory.uncertainty: Entirely unvalidated for human clinical response.
pred_tum_human_exploratory.limitations: No clinical efficacy / cure / survival / dose recommendation. Not shown by default (no human melanoma population).
